summary: Sep. 7 Atlas ISR catch-up: Iran Hormuz restricted-zone escalation, UAE bypass adaptation, Kfar Rumman escalation, Saudi-tanker crew rescue, Iranian missile messaging and domestic fuel-price pressure.

sources.title: Iran warns US energy assets in Gulf are vulnerable after latest clashes
UAE says its energy exports will not be 'held hostage' by Iran war
Israeli strikes on southern Lebanese town kill 12 as fears of escalation mount
Israeli airstrikes on Lebanese village kill 12, plus other key Mideast developments

events.summary: Iranian officials said Tehran would announce a new restricted Gulf zone/shipping corridor and warned that regional energy assets were vulnerable to retaliation. The announced zone and associated vessel-sanctions threat were coercive policy claims, not recognized sovereignty or an agreed navigation regime.
events.adjudication_note: Preserves announced coercive posture separately from recognized legal control or an implemented permanent agreement.

events.summary: The UAE said it was expanding eastern port capacity, pipelines and trade corridors so energy exports and economic activity would not be held hostage to Hormuz disruption.
events.adjudication_note: Records structural Gulf adaptation that reduces dependence on the Strait without eliminating Iranian disruption leverage.

events.summary: Israeli strikes on Kfar Rumman in southern Lebanon killed 12 people, including two children. Israel said it targeted weapons-transfer activity; Hezbollah-linked operational claims and target status remained source-bounded.
events.adjudication_note: Casualty count is supported; target/affiliation claims remain separately attributed.

events.summary: Oman rescued 16 crew members from a Saudi tanker attacked near the Strait of Hormuz; seven crew remained missing in contemporaneous reporting.
events.adjudication_note: Crew status is recorded; vessel damage/loss outcome is not promoted beyond the source.

events.summary: Iran publicly showcased the Qassem Basir ballistic missile and presented it as evidence of improved strike capability and a more preemptive posture.
events.adjudication_note: Existence/showcase is observed reporting; performance and effectiveness claims are not independently validated here.

events.summary: Iran raised domestic fuel prices amid deepening wartime economic pressure.
events.adjudication_note: Domestic price action is evidence of economic adjustment/pressure, not by itself proof of regime instability.

record.notes: Twelve killed, including two children; affiliation/target status of all victims is not treated as resolved.
